name: Camena Oracle
body:
Camena CR
12

A beautiful female figure emerges from the pond, her body apparently composed entirely of water, a melodious song on her lips as she advances towards you.

XP 19,200
Naiad oracle (seer) 12
N Medium fey (water)
Init +5; Senses low-light vision, water sight (scrying 12 rounds/day); Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 93 (12d8+36)
Fort +8, Ref +8, Will +11
Defensive Abilities ice armor 12 hours/day (+6 armor bonus on AC), water bond

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee +2 liberating frost dagger +13/+8 (1d4+3 +1d6 cold/19-20)
Ranged +2 liberating frost dagger +13/+8 (1d4+3 +1d6 cold/19-20)
Special Attacks punitive transformation 6/day (12 rounds, DC 22)
Oracle Spells Known (CL 12th [14 when within 3,000 ft. from her bonded site]; concentration +18)

6th Level (4/day)—legend loreM, mass cure moderate wounds, music of the spheres
5th level (6/day)—commune, greater command (DC 22), mass cure light wounds, summon nature’s ally V, true seeingM, wall of thorns
4th level (7/day)—control water (DC 20), cure critical wounds, divination, guardian of faith, rising water, scryingM (DC 20), wave form (DC 20)
3rd level (7/day)—aqueous orb (DC 19), claraudience/clairvoyanceM, dispel magic, cure serious wounds, hydraulic torrent, life current, magic vestment, water walk
2nd level (8/day)—aquatic cavalry, augury, consecrate, cure moderate wounds, detect thoughtsM (DC 17), eagle’s splendor, enthrall (DC 19), hold person (DC 19), riversight
1st level (8/day)—bless, bless water, charm animals (DC 18), cure light wounds, endure elements, hydraulic push, obscuring mist, sanctuary, touch of the sea M
0th-Level (at will)—create water, detect magic, detect poison, guidance, light, know direction, mending, purify food and drink, read magic, resistance, stabilize, virtue

Mystery Waves

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 12, Con 16, Int 10, Wis 15, Cha 22
Base Atk +9; CMB +10; CMD 20
Feats Dodge, Extra Revelation, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Spell Focus (enchantment), Weapon Focus (dagger)
Skills Knowledge (nature) +17, Knowledge (religion) +15, Perform (string) +18, Swim +16; Racial Modifiers +2 Handle Animal, +2 Knowledge (nature)
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ gift of prophecy 1/day, inspiration, natural divination 4/day, oracle’s curse (site-bound), water form 1/day (12 hours, Large water elemental, elemental body III)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Gift of Prophecy (Su)

Once per day, the camena oracle can enter a trance to gain a glimpse of the future. This trance lasts for 1 minute, which must be uninterrupted and during which she can take no other actions. The knowledge she gains is equivalent to a commune spell. This spell effect does not require material components.

Heroic Gear (Ex)

The camena possesses gear as a PC of her level.

This increases her total CR by +1.

Ice Armor (Su)

The camena oracle can conjure an armor of ice that grants her a +6 armor bonus. In cold conditions, the armor bonus (and DR bonus) increases by 2; in very hot conditions it decreases by 2. The camena can use this armor for 1 hour per day per oracle level. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-hour increments. (A camena’s ice armor takes the appearance of a diaphanous veil made of water).

Inspiration (Su)

A camena can choose another intelligent creature to inspire by giving that creature a token (typically a lock of her hair). As long as the creature carries the camena’s token and retains her favor, that creature gains a +2 insight bonus on Will saving throws and Craft and Perform checks. The camena retains a link to her token and its carrier as if she had cast a greater status spell on the carrier. The camena can end this effect at any time as a free action. A single camena can only inspire one other creature at a time in this manner.

Natural Divination (Ex)

The camena oracle can read the entrails of a freshly killed animal or humanoid to gain an insight bonus equal to her Charisma modifier on one saving throw. Alternatively, by observing and interpreting the flights of birds, the camena may apply a +10 competence bonus on any one skill check. Finally, by charting marks in dirt or stone, or observing the behavior of sand when thrown into the wind, the camena gains a +4 insight bonus on one initiative check. These bonuses must be used during the next 24 hours and the camena must declare she is using the bonus before the check or save is made. Making a natural divination takes 10 minutes. The camena may use natural divination (in any combination) 4 times per day.

Punitive Transformation (Su)

The camena oracle can transform an opponent into a harmless animal as if using baleful polymorph.

This transformation lasts 1 round per oracle level. Transforming another creature causes the first to immediately revert to normal.

The camena may use this ability a number of times per day equal to her Charisma modifier.

Site-Bound Curse

The camena oracle is bound to a particular 10-foot square, and must remain within 3,000 feet of that site or immediately become sickened. She must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save each minute she spends outside of the boundary or become nauseated. For every hour spent outside of the boundary, the camena also takes 1d4 points of Constitution damage (no save).

When within range of her bonded site, the camena gains a +2 bonus to her caster level when casting oracle spells.

Water Bond (Su)

A camena gains strength from a pond, lake, river, or other body of fresh water by bonding with it. While within 1 mile of her bonded body of water, she gains a +2 insight bonus to Armor Class and a +2 racial bonus on saving throws (these bonuses are not included in the stats above). Once per day as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity, a camena can forge a bond with a body of fresh water.

Water Form (Su)

As a standard action, the camena oracle can assume the form of a Large water elemental, as elemental body III.

She can use this ability once per day, but the duration is 1 hour/level.

Water Sight (Su)

The camena oracle can see through fog and mist without penalty as long as there is enough light to allow her to see normally.

She can also use any calm pool of water at least 1 foot in diameter as a scrying device, as if using the scrying spell. The camena can use the scrying abilities for a number of rounds per day equal to her oracle level, but these rounds do not need to be consecutive.

ECOLOGY

Environment any freshwater
Organization solitary, school (1 plus 2-5 naiads of 1st-3rd level), or court (1-4 plus 1-6 hippocampi, 2-12 naiads of 1st-3rd level, 2-10 electric eels, and 1-2 anguane)
Treasure PC gear (+2 liberating frost dagger, amulet of natural armor +4, belt of physical perfection +2, greater ring of revelation, harp of charming, headband of mental prowess +2 [Wis, Cha], ring of resistance +1)

Camenae are powerful naiads who guard holy springs and rule over entire regions rich in water courses, small lakes, and water meadows, in the same way hamadryads rule over forests.

They also are said to patronize arts and inspire the creation of epics and works of architecture, similarly to muses. Lesser naiads pay their respect to camenae, and human poets, rulers and philosophers seek them for inspiration and wisdom.
